06 /HOW WE’LL WORK TOGETHER

FROM “WHAT IF”
TO “THAT’S IT.”

A proposed process that keeps us aligned,
from the first conversation to the final files.

  1. 01

    Discover

    We start with your story, your audience, and what you want the design to do.

  2. 02

    Define

    Together, we shape a clear brief, a visual direction, and the scope of the work.

  3. 03

    Design

    I explore ideas and turn the chosen direction into considered visual designs.

  4. 04

    Refine

    We review the work and use your feedback to strengthen the details.

  5. 05

    Deliver

    You receive the agreed design files, ready for their intended use.

08 /BEFORE WE BEGIN

A FEW
GOOD QUESTIONS.

Have something else in mind?
Let’s have a conversation

01What can we create together?

Brand identities, social media visuals, website and app interfaces, Canva templates, posters, marketing materials, and YouTube thumbnails. Tell me what you have in mind and we can work out the right scope.

02How do I start a project?

Send a message with a little about your business and what you would like to create. Use the project form when available, or reach me through Facebook or Instagram.

03What should I include in my brief?

Your goal, audience, required designs, preferred timing, and any brand assets or references are a useful start. Include your budget if you already have one in mind.

04What does collaboration look like?

The proposed process is Discover, Define, Design, Refine, and Deliver. We agree on scope, feedback stages, and timing before the work begins.

05Can I get editable design files?

Editable Canva templates are one of my services. Let me know which files you need to edit so we can agree on formats and handover as part of your project.

06Where can I contact you?

You can reach me through the personal Facebook and Instagram links below. When the project form is available, you can also send a brief directly from this website.
